# Tuna Provider

Manage Tuna resources: tunnels, domains, gateways and access policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11"

  required_providers {
    tuna = {
      source = "yuccastream/tuna"
    }
  }
}

provider "tuna" {
  # Or via the TUNA_API_KEY / TUNA_API_URL environment variables
  api_key = var.tuna_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Tuna API key. May also be set via the TUNA_API_KEY environment variable.
- `api_url` (String) Tuna API URL. May also be set via the TUNA_API_URL environment variable. Defaults to https://api.tuna.am.
